en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Salim, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> appointed Shurayh as the judge, stipulated upon him that he would not enforce the judgement without presenting it to him<sup>asws</sup> (first)’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn Salim who has narrated the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that ’
Amir al-Mu’minin, Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, appointed Shurayh as a judge with the condition that his judgments will take effect only after they are shown to him (Imam Ali, ‘Alayhi al-Salam).”
